Visualize miQC classifications after geometry validation

Source: R/check_miQC_predictions.R
check_miQC_predictions.Rd

Creates diagnostic scatter plots for miQC predictions after adjust_classification().

Usage

check_miQC_predictions(
  flexmix_list,
  sample_name = NULL,
  add_unadjusted_prediction = FALSE,
  add_compared_prediction = FALSE,
  add_probability = FALSE,
  adjustment_method = c("original_check", "geometry_check"),
  x_values = "model_column",
  point_size = 1,
  point_alpha = 0.8,
  color_lines = c(discard = "black", keep = "blue"),
  color_points = c(discard = "dimgrey", keep = "cornflowerblue"),
  shape_geom = c(unchanged = 1, geom_pass = 15, geom_fail = 4),
  color_regions = list(geometry_check = c(valid = "#99D696", converge = "#F2DB68",
    invalid = "#D6A696"), original_check = c(unchanged = "#99D696", below_boundary =
    "#F2DB68", left_cutoff = "#D6A696")),
  color_compare = c(both_keep = "#6495ED", both_discard = "#A9A9A9", keep_orig =
    "#6932C2", keep_geom = "#123EA3"),
  combine_plots = TRUE
)

Arguments

flexmix_list

The list object returned by run_miQCadj() with required flexmix_data and model_info slots.

sample_name

Character scalar, optional. Sample name to be used for the plots. A prefix paste0(sample_name, ": ") will either be used for each plot, if combine_plots=FALSE, or for the global plot only, if combine_plots=TRUE. Defaults to NULL.

add_unadjusted_prediction

Logical Scalar. Whether the unadjusted prediction plot for "miQC.keep", should be re-created. Defaults to FALSE.

add_compared_prediction

Logical Scalar. Whether the plot comparing the post-hoc prediction adjustments "miQC.keep_adj_compared" created by adjust_classification(), if both adjustment methods were applied, should should be created. Defaults to FALSE.

add_probability

Logical Scalar. Whether the plot with the probability for each cell belonging to the compromised compartment "miQC.prob_invalid", should be re-created. Defaults to FALSE.

adjustment_method

Character Scalar or Vector, optional. Name of method(s) used for geometric prediction adjustments or NULL. Available options include original_check with required columns miQC.keep_orig_adj, miQC.orig_adj, and miQC.orig_region and geometry_check with miQC.keep_geom_adj, miQC.geom_adj, and miQC.geom_region in flexmix_data. By default plots for both methods will be created.

x_values

Character Scalar. Available options include model_column (default) or complexity_column. Will return identical plots for linear, spline, polynomial, and polynomial_raw models. For one-dimensional models model_column will return plots with decreasing mitochondrial percentage using ranked cell indices in the x-axis. If complexity_column had been provided to run_miQCadj() values from complexity_column can be used as x_values.

point_size

Positive Numeric. Specification of the point size. Defaults to 1.

point_alpha

Positive Numeric. Specification of the transparency of the points. Defaults to 1.

color_lines

Named character vector, optional. Specifying the colors for keep and discard classifications, will plot lines for keep/discard classification curves based on aggregated medians. Defaults to c(discard = "black", keep = "blue").

color_points

Named character vector for keep/discard point color values with names c("discard", "keep"). Defaults to c(discard = "dimgrey", keep = "cornflowerblue")

shape_geom

Named character vector specifying the shapes for geometry-based adjustments. Defaults to c(unchanged = 1, geom_pass = 15, geom_fail = 4).

color_regions

Named character vector specifying the colors for geometry-based regions. Defaults to c(valid="#81F168", invalid="#E28861", converge="gold").

color_compare

Named character vector specifying the colors for comparing predictions by original_check and geometry_check. Defaults to c(both_keep = "#6495ED", both_discard = "#A9A9A9", keep_orig= "#6932C2", keep_geom="#123EA3")

combine_plots

Logical Scalar. Whether the list of plots should be combined into a 2-column-grid using patchwork. Defaults to TRUE.

Value

If combine_plots=FALSE named list of ggplot objects. Depending on the requested adjustment_method, and the additional plots, it may include:

  • unadjusted_classificationOriginal keep/discard classifications.

  • prediction_comparisonComparing keep/discard classifications from original_check and geometry_check. Can only be created, if both adjustment methods were applied, though the plot can be created independently.

  • probabilityPosterior invalid probabilities.

  • original_adjusted_classificationAdjusted classifications using original prediction adjustments.

  • original_region_adjustmentsRegion-related adjustments performed by original prediction adjustments.

  • geometry_adjusted_classificationAdjusted classifications using geometruc prediction adjustments.

  • geometry_region_adjustmentsRegion-related adjustments performed by geometric prediction adjustments.

If combine_plots=TRUE (default) the items will be combined into a 2-column grid using patchwork with sample_name being used for the global title, only.

Examples

if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
plots <- check_miQC_predictions(flexmix_list, sample_name = "Sample")
# show combined plot grid
print(plots)
} # }
